title: Load balancing per replica (HTTP + gRPC)
description: Per-replica request rate, share, active requests, p50/p95 and errors for HTTP and gRPC behind Envoy. All rates and quantiles use a 30 s window.

panels.title: HTTP — GET /forecast through Envoy :8080
Request rate per replica (30 s window)
panels.description: Requests per second each replica handled. Window: 30 s sliding (rate/quantile over [30s]), scrape every 5 s. Excludes /metrics, /health and gRPC health checks.

panels.title: Share of total traffic (30 s window)
panels.description: Each replica's rate divided by the total. Dashed line = 33.3% (equal round robin). Window: 30 s sliding (rate/quantile over [30s]), scrape every 5 s.

targets.expr:
(sum by (replica) (rate(weather_http_requests_total{job="weather-app", endpoint!~"/metrics|/health"}[30s]))
  or sum by (replica) (up{job="weather-app"}) * 0)
/ ignoring(replica) group_left
sum(rate(weather_http_requests_total{job="weather-app", endpoint!~"/metrics|/health"}[30s]))

panels.title: Share over selected time range
panels.description: Share of all requests in the dashboard's time range (increase over $__range). Set the time range to a run's window to read that run's A/B/C split.

targets.expr:
(sum by (replica) (increase(weather_http_requests_total{job="weather-app", endpoint!~"/metrics|/health"}[$__range]))
  or sum by (replica) (up{job="weather-app"}) * 0)
/ ignoring(replica) group_left
sum(increase(weather_http_requests_total{job="weather-app", endpoint!~"/metrics|/health"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Requests in selected time range
panels.description: Requests each replica handled in the dashboard's time range (Prometheus increase(); may be slightly fractional). Compare with Envoy's access log for the same range.

panels.title: Active requests per replica
panels.description: In-progress requests per replica (gauge, sampled every 5 s). Minus 1 because the HTTP middleware also counts the /metrics scrape that reads it.

panels.title: p50 / p95 response time per replica (30 s window)
panels.description: Server-side latency estimated from histogram buckets (linear interpolation inside a bucket). Window: 30 s sliding (rate/quantile over [30s]), scrape every 5 s.

panels.title: Errors by status per replica (30 s window)
panels.description: Non-success responses per second, by replica and status. Empty = no errors. Window: 30 s sliding (rate/quantile over [30s]), scrape every 5 s.

panels.title: gRPC — GetForecast through Envoy :50051
Request rate per replica (30 s window)
panels.description: Requests per second each replica handled. Window: 30 s sliding (rate/quantile over [30s]), scrape every 5 s. Excludes /metrics, /health and gRPC health checks.

panels.title: Share of total traffic (30 s window)
panels.description: Each replica's rate divided by the total. Dashed line = 33.3% (equal round robin). Window: 30 s sliding (rate/quantile over [30s]), scrape every 5 s.

targets.expr:
(sum by (replica) (rate(weather_grpc_requests_total{job="weather-grpc", rpc_method!="Check"}[30s]))
  or sum by (replica) (up{job="weather-grpc"}) * 0)
/ ignoring(replica) group_left
sum(rate(weather_grpc_requests_total{job="weather-grpc", rpc_method!="Check"}[30s]))

panels.title: Share over selected time range
panels.description: Share of all requests in the dashboard's time range (increase over $__range). Set the time range to a run's window to read that run's A/B/C split.

targets.expr:
(sum by (replica) (increase(weather_grpc_requests_total{job="weather-grpc", rpc_method!="Check"}[$__range]))
  or sum by (replica) (up{job="weather-grpc"}) * 0)
/ ignoring(replica) group_left
sum(increase(weather_grpc_requests_total{job="weather-grpc", rpc_method!="Check"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Requests in selected time range
panels.description: Requests each replica handled in the dashboard's time range (Prometheus increase(); may be slightly fractional). Compare with Envoy's access log for the same range.

panels.title: Active requests per replica
panels.description: In-flight calls per replica (gauge, sampled every 5 s); health checks excluded.

targets.expr:
sum by (replica) (weather_grpc_in_flight_calls{job="weather-grpc", rpc_method!="Check"})
  or sum by (replica) (up{job="weather-grpc"}) * 0

panels.title: p50 / p95 response time per replica (30 s window)
panels.description: Server-side latency estimated from histogram buckets (linear interpolation inside a bucket). Window: 30 s sliding (rate/quantile over [30s]), scrape every 5 s.

panels.title: Errors by status per replica (30 s window)
panels.description: Non-success responses per second, by replica and grpc_code. Empty = no errors. Window: 30 s sliding (rate/quantile over [30s]), scrape every 5 s.

panels.title: Envoy — the proxy's own view
Responses Envoy sent to clients, by class (30 s window)
panels.description: Includes errors Envoy generated itself (no healthy replica, connection failure) that never reach a replica's metrics.

panels.title: Active upstream requests per cluster
panels.description: Requests Envoy currently has outstanding to each cluster (all endpoints together).

panels.title: Endpoints per cluster: healthy vs total
panels.description: How many replicas each cluster lists and how many Envoy considers healthy (Part A: 1; Part C: 3; Part D: drops when B is stopped).
